children: Malaysia's telecommunications sector is expected to see a seasonally stronger 2H, with longer-term growth drivers supporting fixed-line players, RHB IB analyst Jeffrey Tan says in a note. Mobile earnings are expected to improve, as prepaid customer spending stabilizes following recent product changes, he says. CelcomDigi could also see stronger profit growth in 2027 as cost-saving measures gain traction. Telekom Malaysia could also see lower costs after switching its 5G network access provider to U Mobile from Digital Nasional, he adds. RHB maintains a neutral rating on the Malaysian telco sector, pegging Telekom Malaysia and CelcomDigi as top picks. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
